notes: Fiscal year ended July 31, 2026 (matches data.js fy 'Jul 2026'). Financial figures are from the FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001327567-26-000023, filed September 10, 2026), checked against SEC XBRL; FY2026 amounts are reported in whole millions. Ownership is from the proxy published after that year (DEF 14A, accession 0001308179-26-000432), as of September 18, 2026. In fiscal 2026 the company acquired Chronosphere (January 2026) and CyberArk Software (February 11, 2026; $18,862 million of the consideration was paid in stock), which raised shares outstanding to about 818 million. LEADER: Nikesh Arora (Chair and CEO) beneficially owned 2,158,729 shares, less than 1% (marked * in the proxy), so pctEconomic is null. The total includes 1,056,783 PSU shares vesting within 60 days and excludes 2,958,459 vested and deferred RSU/PSU shares; on October 12, 2026 the Aurora Trust pledged up to 500,000 shares under a prepaid variable forward contract while keeping beneficial ownership. HOLDERS: the proxy gives the 13G filing dates (Vanguard Capital Management April 30, 2026; BlackRock 13G/A January 26, 2024, stale) but not the dates the holdings refer to, so asOf is null. BUYBACKS exclude $126 million of taxes paid on net share settlement of equity awards. STOCK COMP: the note total ($1,815 million) is used; the cash-flow add-back is $1,774 million. GEOGRAPHY: the 'Total Americas' subtotal is omitted to avoid double counting.
